honesty.product: N of M live x402 sellers delivered to a real paying client on their last probe.
honesty.n: resources whose latest probe is delivered (paid AND 200 AND settlement_tx).
honesty.m: resources whose latest probe was a real attempt: delivered or failed. not_attempted (our gate/client stopped first) is excluded from both.
honesty.not_this: Not delivery_verified (needs >=3 external payers), not a quality score, not fulfillment proof: 200 + JSON is what a paying client received, nothing more.

reproduce_sql:
WITH latest AS (
SELECT DISTINCT ON (resource_url)
    resource_url, outcome, failure_class, http_status, settlement_tx,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM probed_at)::bigint AS probed_at_unix,
    probe_source, run_label, quoted_micro
FROM x402_delivery_probes
ORDER BY resource_url, probed_at DESC, pass_no DESC, id DESC
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'delivered')::int AS n_delivered,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome IN ('delivered','failed'))::int AS m_attempted,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'not_attempted')::int AS not_attempted,
    MAX(probed_at_unix)::bigint AS latest_probe_unix
FROM latest
